entities.name: Laulu Fetauimalemau Mata'afa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Masiofo Laʻulu Fetauimalemau Mataʻafa, also known as Fetaui Mataʻafa, was a Samoan politician, chieftain and diplomat who served as a member of parliament for Lotofaga from 1975 to 1976, and again from 1979 to 1982. Mata'afa was later Samoa's first high commissioner to New Zealand. She was also the wife of Samoa's first Prime Minister, Fiame Mata'afa Faumuina Mulinu'u II. Their daughter, Fiamē Naomi Mataʻafa, is a matai high chieftess and former Cabinet Minister, former Deputy Prime Minister and current Prime Minister of Samoa.
